name: Collect activity logs from Workday
description: Fetch activity logs from Workday Activity Logging API

chunk_size.description: Maximum chunk size for batch processing

limit.description: Number of records to fetch per API request

instances_returned.description: Workday 'instancesReturned' parameter: maximum pool of activity instances per time window, expressed in units of 10,000 (1 = 10,000 records, 25 = 250,000). Defaults to 1 (most performant); raise it for high-volume tenants that exceed 10,000 events per window to avoid truncation.
